hits.title: G2 Acquires Software Advice
hits.snippet: # G2 Acquires Software Advice ... Acquired by ... UndisclosedJan 29, 2026 ... On January 29, 2026, G2, based in Chicago, acquired Software Advice in a business acquisition for an undisclosed amount. This deal unites two significant players in the business software review and comparison space. G2, founded in 2012, operates a freemium platform leveraging peer reviews to disrupt traditional B2B software evaluation. Software Advice, established in 2005, provides advisory services, research, and user reviews across over 300 software market categories. Previously acquired by Gartner in 2014, Software Advice connects businesses with software vendors, generating revenue through vendor partnerships.
